meta.title: Stats pattern
meta.description: The stats section in its two layouts: voyager-open/stats, three figures in a row, and voyager-open/stats-band, the same figures beside a heading. Each figure is the year founded, the rating or the review count from Settings > Site Data, never typed in. Until those are filled in, each figure shows its own text, which names the field.
meta.author: voyager-marketing
